key_observation: Q=0 case requires lifted terms to sum to I_3 in block (0,0) with exact cancellation in all 8 other blocks. Each such term also participates in core slices, creating coupled constraints.

structural_implications.Q_equals_zero: Δ has rank 3, supported only on block (0,0). Lifted terms cannot be block-confined without u_i=0 contradiction. Must use terms with cross-block components that exactly cancel.
structural_implications.Q_nonzero: Δ = M_0 + q⊗r has rank 2-4. Block structure determined by q,r sub-vectors. Imposes bilinear factorization constraint on lifted subset of core terms.
